id: title:Gilbert09:resubmit a report bing fails to build

review.posthog_relevance: Adds exception handling and retry configuration for Bing Ads warehouse ingestion, potentially improving reliability of warehouse ingestion runs by recovering from transient SDK failures.
review.reason: Adds Bing Ads SDK exception handling, report generation retry configuration, and a wrapper function with sleep delay for report generation. This could help recover from transient failures in warehouse ingestion.
review.uncertainty: The actual benefit depends on the frequency and severity of Bing Ads SDK failures, which is not established by the code alone. The implementation is bounded and localized to warehouse ingestion, not systemic. No tests or broader validation are visible.
